newsitem.title: USA: LADD Furniture to sell Daystrom plant.
newsitem.headline: LADD Furniture to sell Daystrom plant.

text.p: LADD Furniture Inc said on Tuesday it entered into a contract to sell its Daystrom Furniture manufacturing facility in South Boston, Va. for an undisclosed price.
The company said it did not expect to take a charge for the sale. The plant was closed recently because of LADD's previously-announced liquidation of Daystrom, a former LADD operating company.
The company said it expected to complete the sale before the end of its fiscal year and to use the proceeds to reduce debt. It was not immediately available to comment on who the buyer was.

President and Chief Executive Officer Fred Schuermann, Jr. said: "The sale of this manufacturing facility will complete our liquidation of the Daystrom assets. During the quarter just ended, LADD finalized the sale of the remaining Daystrom inventories and completed a very successful auction of Daystrom's equipment assets."
